finalText:
All 13 reservations on AA918 are re-protected, and each passenger has been notified once. There were no open queue requests, and no bulletins were in effect. Every change was free of change fee and fare difference.

| Passenger (reservation) | New itinerary | Cabin | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chloe Park (R6103, platinum) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15–12:25 | business | none (arrives earlier) |
| Iris Vance (R6109, platinum) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15–12:25 | premium economy | none (arrives earlier) |
| Jun Takeda (R6110) and Kofi Mensah (R6111), group G-7 | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | economy, together | none (1h35 later) |
| Ben Okafor (R6102, gold) | DL512, 3 Aug, 12:30–18:40 | economy | 15000 compensation |
| Farid Haddad (R6106, gold) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15–12:25 | basic economy | none (arrives earlier) |
| Lea Sorensen (R6112, gold) | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | business | none (1h35 later) |
| Dev Mehta (R6104, silver) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40–23:50, then AA1410 ORD→BOS, 4 Aug, 09:00–12:25 | economy | 30000 compensation and 18000 hotel |
| Mo Farah (R6113, silver) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40–23:50, then AA1410 ORD→BOS, 4 Aug, 09:00–12:25 | economy | 30000 compensation and 18000 hotel |
| Hugo Brandt (R6108, silver) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40–23:50 | economy | 30000 compensation |
| Grace Liu (R6107) | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | economy | 24000 compensation (capped at her fare) and 18000 hotel |
| Ana Ruiz (R6101) | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | economy | 30000 compensation and 18000 hotel |
| Elena Fox (R6105) | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05–15:15 | basic economy | none (1h35 later) |

- **Upgrades:** Iris (platinum) and Lea (gold) each travel alone on a single flight, and their own cabin was full on a flight that gets them there sooner than any other option in that cabin. So each is seated one cabin higher on that flight. Nobody else was upgraded, and the G-7 group was not split or upgraded.
- **Connections:** The original AA1402 connection could not be kept for Dev and Mo. They arrive in Chicago late on 3 Aug, so I rebooked their onward leg onto the next morning's AA1410, which is a valid connection.

I did not re-read the reservations or the ledger at the end, so I have not independently re-checked the final bookings and voucher entries beyond each tool's confirmation. I did not resolve any queue requests, since there were none.
